book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Mako

content: Mabholu gha kutoghola na kulekana
Yesu akabhokiki panihapa na kujenda ku Yudea, mbaka kwihi ja Nkoka Yoludani. Lipogha likolongwa la bhandu lakunjendi kabheti, najombi akabhabholiki ngati mowabheli ntetu waki.
Panihapa Mafalisayo bhakunjendili, na kwa kundenga bhakundalukile, “Bho, Amuli jaka Chapanga le jijetakela mwanalomi kundeka nhwanu wake?”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Bho, Musa akundaghalaki bhole?”
Na bhombi bhakamuyangike, “Musa akalaghalaki mwanalomi ngaandeka nhwanu waki mbaka ampekya baluwa ja kulekana na kundeka.”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Musa akundembi amuli jeniheji kwa ndandi ja kunonopa kwa mitima jinu.
Nambu kutumbu kubhombakeka ndema, Chapanga akumbombiki mwanalomi na mbomba.
Bhela mwanalomi anaandeka tati waki na mabhu waki, na kulombana papamu na nhwanu waki machobha ghokape,
na bhombi bhabheli habha anabhakubhaje hyegha jimu. Bhela, bhombi nga bhabheli kabhete, nambu hyegha jimu.
Bhela, chealombanishi Chapanga, mundu ngayilombola.”
Pabhakajingi kabheti mu nyumba, bhabhulwa bhaki bhakundaluki panani ja libholu lenihele.
Na jombi akabhapwaghile, “Joandeka nhwanu waki na kuntoghola jongi, antende ugoni nhwanu waki.
Bhelabhela na mbomba joandeka ndomi waki na kutoghuleka na jongi, atenda ugone.”
Yesu abhapengalela bhana bhachoku bhachoku
Bhandu bhakundeti Yesu bhana bhachoku bhachoku nahuli abhapengalyaje, nambu bhabhulwa bhaki bhakabhalakalile.

Yesu paakaweni bhenibhela, akahakalili namaa, akabhapwaghile, “Mwabhaleka bhana abhabha bhahika kwangu nepani, wala ngamwahibhalila, maghambu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ubhi kwa ndandi ja bhandu bhabhabhi ngati bhana abhabha.
Numpwaghi chakaka, mundu jokapi jwangakupala kujopalela Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ngati mwana nchoku ngaijingi monihomu ng'o.”
Bhela akabhajopiki bhana habha, akabhabheki mabhoku na kubhapengalela.
Mundu mwana hindu yamahele
Yesu patumbula kabheti mwanja waki, mundu jumu akunkembalili, akunchikamili palongi jaki, na kundalukila, “Mbola wambone, bho, ndenda bhole nahuli mbata kuupwelela womi wa mileli?”
Yesu akamuyangike, “Bho, mbona unoha wambone? Njeta joabhi wambone nambu jumu pela, yani Chapanga kanjika jaki.
Wimanyi le amuli, ‘Ngawihenga ugoni, ngawikoma, ngawijibha, ngawilonge upuhe, ngawikolowa, untopilaje tati waku na mabhu waku.’ ”
Na jombi akayangike, “Mbola, ghanihagha ghokapi naghakamwili kutumbu umwana wangu.”

Yesu akundingali, na kumpala, akumpwaghile, “Chihighali chindu chimu. Ujendaje ukalombisaje kila chindu cheubhi nachu, ukabhapekya bhahochu mbija yene, na wenga walibhekila chikoku kunani kumahunde. Anautehi bhenibhela, utola msalaba waku, na uhika unyengalyaje.”
Paakajowini ghanihagha, akatondike, akabhokiki koni mtima umbina, ndandi akabhi na hindu yamahele na ngacheakapaliki kuighabha hindu yaki.
Yesu akalingali ipambala yokapi, akabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki, “Kunonwipi namaa kwa bhanahindu yamahele kujingi mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga!”
Bhabhulwa bhaki bhakakangichi kwa malobhi ghaki. Yesu akabhapwaghi kabhete, “Bhana bhangu, kunonwipi namaa kwa bhandu bhabhahobhalela hindu yamaheli, kujingila mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga!
Kupepwiki namaa kwa chinyama chechilowakeka ngamia kuholota mu limboghi la sindano, kuliku mwanahindu yamaheli kujingi mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga!”
Bhabhulwa bhaki bhakakangichi namaa, bhakalaluhine, “Bho, nane henu, joanawezaje kukengaleka?”
Yesu akabhalingalili, na kubhapwaghila, “Kwa bhandu ngakuwezikana, nambu kwaka Chapanga ngabhela, ndandi kwaka Chapanga kila chindu chiwezikana.”
Kabheti Petulu akumpwaghile, “Lingalyaje! Na tepani bhole? Tughalekiki ghokapi, na kukujengalela wehapa!”
Yesu akapwaghike, “Chakaka numpwaghila, kila mundu joajilehi nyumba, au bhalongu, au bhalombu, au mabhu, au atati, au bhana, au mighonda kwa ndandi jangu na kwa ndandi ja Malobhi Manyahi,
anaajopalyaje mala mia jimu nakanope chikahi cha sajenu. Nyumba, ndongu, ndombu, mabhu, bhana na mighonda papamu na mang'ahiku, na mu ndema ghouhika anaajopalyaje womi wa mileli.
Nambu bhamaheli bhabhahobhaleka kubha bhakutumbula sajenu bhibya bhakujomukela, na bhabhabhi bha kujomukela sajenu bhibya bhakutumbula.”
Yesu alonge pakatatu panani ja kupotela na kuhyoka kwaki

Bhela, bhakabhi mwindela kukwela ku Yelusalemu, na Yesu akabhi abhalongulile. Bhabhulwa bhaki bhakabhi na lujoghopo, na bhandu bhabhajengalyaje bhakajowipi. Yesu akabhatohi kabheti punkeghi komi na bhabheli bhala, na kutumbula kubhapwaghila mambu ghaghumpataje.

Akabhapwaghile, “Ndingalyaje, tukwela kujenda ku Yelusalemu. Na konihoku Mwana waka Mundu anabhumpelaka mu mabhoku gha bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhabhola bha Shelia, na bhombi anabhuntemula apotilaje na kubhapeke bhandu bha mataifa ghange.
Na bhombi anabhundongamaje, anabhunhunila imata, bhandapula chiboku cha ndomondo na kunkoma. Nambu lichobha la katatu anahyokaje.”
Lilobhu laka Yakobo na Yohana
Yakobo na Yohana bhana bhaka Zebedayo, bhakunjendi Yesu na kumpwaghila, “Mbola, tupala utuhengila chindu chetakulobhaje.”
Yesu akabhalalukile, “Bho, mpala nunhengila kike?”
Bhakamuyangike, “Utujetakalyaje kutama jumu upambala wa kumalelelu jaku, na jumu upambala wa kumangeja jaku, mu ulumbalilu waku.”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Ngachemmanyi lendobha! Bho, muweza kunywele chikombi cha mang'ahiku ngati moning'ahikya nepani, na kubatizwa mu ubatizu ngati ghonibatizwaje?”
Bhakamuyangike, “Tuweza.” Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Chakaka mwinywelila mu chikombi cha mang'ahiku chenikunywa nepani, na mwibatizwa ngati monibatizwaje.
Kwa bhala bhabhitama kumalelelu au kumangeja jangu nga lihengu langu kupanga. Nambu mbekanyu jeniheji bhipata bhabhabhekakiki na Chapanga.”
Bhabhulwa bhangi komi bhala pabhakajowini ghanihagha, bhakatumbwi kubhahakali Yakobo na Yohana.

Bhela, Yesu akabhalohiki, na kubhapwaghila, “Bhandu bhabhamanyikana kubha bhatawala bha bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude bhabhatawala bhandu bhabhu kwa makili, na kabheti bhatawala bhe habha bhabhahengela ngati mobhapalila.
Nambu kwinu mabhanganya ngakwikubha bhenibhela, nambu joapala kubha nkolongwa pachilanda jinu, apalika abya ntumika winu.
Joapala kubha wa kutumbula, apalika abya mtumika wa bhokape.
Ndandi Mwana waka Mundu ngachehiki kutumikiwa, nambu kutumikila, na kuubhoha womi waki nahuli kubhalepela bhandu bhamahele.”
Yesu andamiha ngalola Batilomayo

Bhela, bhakahiki ku Yeliko, najombi Yesu paapitika mu muchi hoghu akabya na bhabhulwa bhaki papamu na lipogha likolongwa la bhandu. Mundu jumu ngalola joalowakeka Batilomayo, mwana waka Timayo, akabhi atami punkeghi ja indela akajopa bhunjangatyaje.
Paakajowini kubha Yesu wa ku Nazaleti akabhili apeta pandu panihapa, akatumbwi kujamalila, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daude, umonila chiha!”
Bhandu bhamahele bhakundakalile nahuli atumbalaje, nambu jombi akajonjuki kujamalila, “Mwana waka Daude, umonila chiha!”
Yesu akajemiki, na kupwagha, “Mundohaje.” Bhela, bhakundohiki ngalola jola, bhakumpwaghili, “Ulipekya mtima! Jemaje, akuloha.”
Na jombi akaleki kutali ingobhu jaki, akahombiki, na kunjende Yesu.
Yesu akundalukile, “Bho, upala nukuhengila kike?” Ngalola jola akayangike, “Mbola, nyopa mbata kulola.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Jendaje, uhobhalelu waku ukulamihe.” Palapala ngalola jola akaweziki kulola, na akunjengali Yesu mwindela.
